_comment: This file defines the machine-readable schema for HCP pricing evidence. All value fields are null until a human operator logs into the HCP portal and records confirmed current pricing. FP-001 from CZ-RUN3-FAILURE-PREVENTION-001 is OPEN until this schema is populated by the operator.
fp_001_note: HCP Vault Dedicated pricing is UNVERIFIED. This schema cannot be machine-completed offline. The human operator must follow the capture procedure below.

capture_procedure.step_1: Log into HCP portal at https://portal.cloud.hashicorp.com with authorized identity (jcosat0211@gmail.com or authorized FrostGate operator).
capture_procedure.step_2: Navigate to: Billing > Pricing > Vault > Dedicated (or equivalent current HCP portal path).
capture_procedure.step_3: Confirm the current hourly rate for 'standard_small' tier in AWS us-east-1 region.
capture_procedure.step_4: Record the exact rate (USD/hour), billing unit, any minimum charge, and any additional per-operation charges.
capture_procedure.step_5: Record the date and time of confirmation (UTC), and the validity window (e.g., 'valid as of 2026-10-10, confirm again if more than 30 days have passed').
capture_procedure.step_6: Record the identity of the person who confirmed the price (operator full name and role).
capture_procedure.step_7: Compute SHA-256 fingerprint of the JSON blob: rate + billing_unit + confirmed_at (as deterministic canonical JSON).
capture_procedure.step_8: Populate all null fields in evidence section above.
capture_procedure.step_9: Update pricing_evidence_fingerprint in run3_cost_authorization_request.json with the computed fingerprint.
capture_procedure.step_10: Update request_status in run3_cost_authorization_request.json from BLOCKED_PRICING_UNVERIFIED to PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW only after all evidence fields are non-null.

historical_reference.note: The $321.81 historical figure (ceremony_state.yaml cost_containment.historical_october_usage_usd) covers Runs 1 and 2 ONLY. It is CONSUMED. It MUST NOT be used as a pricing reference or cost ceiling for Run 3.
